subject: hydra
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: five-headed hydra.
Style: God of War.

spec.name: Ashen Five-Headed Hydra
spec.description: A colossal God-of-War-style hydra: a moss-scaled serpent bulk with pale belly scutes, dark dorsal spikes, broken iron shackles and glowing teal runes, five horned heads with open fanged jaws and ember-lit throats rising spread from its shoulders.
spec.layout: Facing +Z the viewer sees a fan of five serpentine necks rising from the shoulders of a massive low serpent chest: the central neck tallest with its head highest at y≈4.0 staring straight ahead, two mid necks at x=±1.1 a head lower, and two outer necks splayed out to x=±1.8 lowest of all, all five jaws open showing teeth. Behind and below them the huge chest dominates the centre, its pale belly plates resting on the floor from z≈-0.8 to z≈2.0, with dark dorsal spikes along its spine and glowing teal rune sigils on each flank plus a broken iron shackle ring at its front. The tail sweeps back from z≈-0.6, tapering and curling upward to a bone spade fin near z=-4.6. Style on every part: ashen desaturated moss-greens with hard flat tonal breaks, weathered bone horn, dark forge-iron shackles and chain links, small glowing teal rune pieces and ember/yellow glow eyes as separate emissive parts, and deep-ink seams and outlines as their own seated pieces.

parts.builds: The serpent chest and front body. A smooth-skinned loft along the spine from z=-0.9 (y≈1.0, radius 0.85) swelling to radius 1.15 at the chest (z≈0.6, spine y≈1.12 so the belly rests on y=0) and easing to radius 1.0 at the shoulders (z≈1.9). Countershaded moss-green scales: scaleDark/scaleMid/scaleHigh drifting over the back and flanks, pale belly below. Underneath, 5-6 rows of broad overlapping armoured belly scutes (belly with thin bellyShade step edges) running the body length, each scute its own shallow slab seated on the tube. Along the spine behind the necks to the hips, 8-9 large dorsal spikes: dark hornDark cones with pale horn tips, shrinking toward the rear, each seated on the sweep surface. Two glowing teal rune sigils per flank (glowTeal, small extruded rune strokes seated in a dark ink recess plate) on the upper flank; a patch of moss scaleHigh tones on upward-facing scale edges. God of War flavour: a broken iron shackle — a thick dark iron (iron) ring with ironDark inner band around the chest just behind the neck bases, its broken chain of 4-5 heavy links (iron, ironDark) trailing down the flank, lowest link resting at y≈0.02.
parts.attaches: Root of the body on the body and shoulders joints; the five necks of the necks part sprout buried inside its front-top around mount neckBase [0, 1.6, 1.35]; the tail part takes over at tailRoot [0, 0.95, -0.6], overlapping the torso's rear by one radius so no seam shows.

parts.builds: The serpent tail from tailRoot [0, 0.95, -0.6]: one smooth-skinned sweep along the tail1-tail4 joints, radius 0.85 tapering to 0.12, running straight back to z≈-3.5 then curling upward (tail tip near [0, 1.9, -4.5]). Same scale paint as the torso so the pattern continues across the join: scaleDark/scaleMid/scaleHigh above, pale belly scutes (belly, bellyShade edges) under the first half only, fading to plain scales behind. Paired dorsal spikes (hornDark bases, horn tips) shrinking from 0.28 to 0.06 along the tail's top, seated on the sweep surface. The tip carries a broad bone spade fin: an extruded flat blade about 0.7 long and 0.45 wide in horn with a hornDark edge rim and a small glowing teal rune stud at its centre. Two weathered iron rings (iron with ironDark bands, dented — broken shackle remnants) cinched around the tail at t≈0.25 and t≈0.45.
parts.attaches: Sweeps over the body and tail1-tail4 joints; its front end buries one radius into the torso part's rear (torso box ends at z=-1.0, tail sweep starts at tailRoot z=-0.6 inside it).

parts.builds: All five serpentine necks rising from the chest top around mount neckBase, each a smooth-skinned sweep on its own neck chain (neckC1-3, neckML1-3, neckMR1-3, neckOL1-3, neckOR1-3), radius 0.34 at the base easing to 0.22 at the head end, tubes ending buried just under each head joint mount so no gap shows when a head turns. Central neck tallest and near vertical with a slight forward S; mid necks bow outward then forward; outer necks splay widest and lowest. Each neck is countershaded front-to-back: pale throat (belly tones) facing forward, scaleDark/scaleMid back, with a thin ink seam ring at each joint bend. Down the top of every neck runs a mane of backward-leaning horn spikes (horn with hornDark roots, 0.14-0.08 tall, about 9 per neck) seated on the sweep's dorsal line. At each neck base a broken iron shackle collar (iron ring, ironDark inner pad) with one or two dangling chain links riding the neck's bone.
parts.attaches: Sprouts buried inside the torso part at mount neckBase; its five neck tips end exactly at the head mounts headC, headML, headMR, headOL, headOR where the two head parts seat their skulls on the head joints.

parts.builds: The richest head, the central one on headC with jaw on jawC — the archetype all other heads repeat. A heavy faceted skull about 0.55 wide and 0.9 long built as angular boxy slabs and a blunt snout frustum in scaleMid with scaleDark shadowed underside and scaleHigh brow ridge, an ink outline seam where skull meets snout. Open jaw at about 25 degrees: the upper jaw is the skull's snout with a maw-dark (maw) roof and two fang rows of conical teeth (tooth, 6 per side, front fangs largest); the lower jaw is a shallower slab on the jawC joint with its own teeth, a throat piece (throat) at the back and an ember glow (glowEmber) deep in the gullet. Two heavy brow horns (horn, hornDark ridged bases) curving back and up from the brow to y≈4.15, plus 3 small horn spikes down the jawline and cheek studs of claw-coloured spikes. Glowing yellow eyes (eyeGlow, small glowing lens parts seated in ink socket rims) under the horned brow. A glowing teal rune (glowTeal strokes in an ink recess) etched on the skull crown. A frayed membrane-red crest web (membrane) stretched between the two rear horn spikes.
parts.attaches: Seats on the headC and jawC joints exactly at mounts headC/jaw line; the necks part's central neck tube ends buried just behind the skull's back edge.

parts.builds: The four flanking heads, built like headsCentral but smaller and varied so the fan reads as individuals: the mid pair (headML/headMR, scale 0.85 of the central head) with forward-curving ibex-style brow horns and two cheek spikes each; the outer pair (headOL/headOR, scale 0.72) with a swept-back single crest fin (horn, hornDark edge) instead of paired horns. Same construction on every head: faceted skull slabs in scaleMid/scaleDark/scaleHigh with ink seam, open jaw on its jaw joint (about 20 degrees) with maw roof, throat piece, ember glow in the gullet, two rows of conical teeth (tooth, 5 per side), glowing eyeGlow eyes in ink sockets, a small glowing teal rune on the crown. Mirror the left/right pairs exactly (s = 1/-1 over x), and keep the mid heads aimed forward-down, the outer heads aimed slightly outward.
parts.attaches: Each head seats on its head joint at mounts headML, headMR, headOL, headOR with jaws on jawML, jawMR, jawOL, jawOR; the necks part's mid and outer neck tubes end buried just behind each skull's back edge.

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec for a five-headed hydra in God of War style, split into 3-6 parts for parallel builders.

God of War style: dark, mythic, ashen, serpentine, weathered stone/metal, glowing sigils, scales, bone, rot-green or ember glow. Hydra: massive serpent body coiled on the ground, five long necks rising, each with a monstrous head with jaws open, glowing eyes, spikes/crests. Rest pose for rigging: necks extended separately, jaws built as upper+lower.

Let me plan the layout:

- Massive serpent body: thick coil resting on y=0, runs along z, maybe a coiled tail. Body length ~6m? A hydra that's big: width maybe 3.2m (five necks spread), height ~4m, length ~6m.
- Five necks rising from the shoulders/front of the body, spread out: two outer, two mid, one central taller. Each neck chain with role "neck", heads with jaws (role "jaw").
- Head: monstrous — heavy skull, horns, glowing eyes, open jaw with teeth.
- Back/crest: dorsal spines along spine, maybe chained armor plates or glowing sigil runes (God of War: glowing green/teal runes like Norse magic).
- Ground: brief says subject only — no extra scenery unless named. Pitch only says hydra. So no ground scenery. Maybe minimal.

Parts split (3-6 parts, even richness):
1. `torso` — the massive serpent body/chest, coiled base, dorsal spikes, belly plates, glowing rune sigils. budget ~180
2. `tail` — serpent tail sweeping back, tapering, fin/spade tip, spikes. budget ~120
3. `necks` — five neck chains rising from shoulder mount (all five? maybe split: necks 1-3 and 4-5, or necks+heads in one part). Five necks each ~40 parts = 200... better split.
   - Part 3: `necksOuter` — two outer necks + two outer heads. ~220
   - Part 4: `necksInner` — central neck tallest + two mid necks + three heads. Hmm heads are expensive (jaws, teeth, horns, eyes).

Maybe better:
1. torso (body, chest, spikes, sigils, belly plates) — 200
2. tail — 130
3. necks (all five neck tubes, shared style) — 180
4. headsRight/left... heads are 5. Split: headsFront (central + 2 mid) and headsOuter (2 outer)? Heads need per-head variation (God of War hydra heads vary slightly). Maybe:
   - part 3: necks (5 necks + neck spikes/manes) — 170
   - part 4: headsMain (central head + two mid heads, richest) — 200
   - part 5: headsOuter (two outer heads) — 150

Total budgets: 200+130+170+200+150 = 850. Good.

Joints skeleton (built in order, parents first):
- root: `body` (spine) at [0, 1.0, 0]? Body center. Actually root joint for the serpent body: at chest, dir forward +Z? Let's define:
  - `body` root, at [0, 0.9, 0.8], dir [0,0,1], role spine — chest.
  - `hips`? For a serpent, spine chain. But spec format lists joints individually. Keep it simpler: root `body`, then `tail1..tail4` chain along back, role tail. But the spec's joints array defines the skeleton all parts share. I should list main joints: body (root spine), tail joints, neck bases. Necks: each neck is a chain — spec lists joints individually? The example lists joints with parents. Five necks × 4 joints each = 20 joints plus heads/jaws = lots. The joints array in the spec — I can list representative ones; but the instruction says "joints is the skeleton, created in this order before any part runs". Each builder calls b.joint themselves? Actually parts list which joints their geometry rides — so joints are created centrally? The system prompt for builders: each writes one function building into a shared builder, joints created in this order before any part runs. So the joints listed in spec are created by the harness presumably, and builders reference them by name.

So I need to enumerate the joints fully? That could be a long list but that's fine. Let me keep joint counts reasonable: 

- `body` root spine at [0, 1.0, 0.6], dir [0,0,1].
- `chest` at [0, 1.1, 1.6]? Hmm.

Simplify: serpent body low, coiled. Let me design geometry:

Hydra body: massive front torso from z=-0.5 to z=2.0, a thick tube radius ~1.0 at chest, lying on ground (belly at y=0, spine center at y~1.0). Behind: tail tapering back to z=-4.5, radius 0.85→0.12, tip maybe raised with a spade.

Actually size: [3.2, 4.2, 6.5]. Height 4.2 from tallest central head.

Five necks rise from front-top of torso (mount `neckRoot` at [0, 1.6, 1.9]) spread like fingers:
- central: tallest, rises to y≈4.0, head at [0, 3.6, 2.9] looking forward/down slightly.
- two mid at x=±0.75, y≈3.3.
- two outer at x=±1.45, y≈2.7, splayed outward.

Each neck: chain of 4 joints. Heads: head joint + jaw joint.

Joints list:
1. body — root, at [0, 1.0, 0.6], dir [0, 0, 1], role spine.
2. tail1..4 — role tail, going back: tail1 [0,0.95,-0.6], tail2 [0,0.9,-1.8], tail3 [0,1.0,-3.0], tail4 [0,1.2,-4.1] (tail tip curls up).
3. neckC1..4 (central neck), role neck, parent body.
4. neckML1..4, neckMR1..4 (mid), parent body.
5. neckOL1..4, neckOR1..4 (outer), parent body.
6. headC, headML, headMR, headOL, headOR — role head, parent last neck joint.
7. jawC etc. — role jaw, parent head.

That's 1 + 4 + 20 + 5 + 5 = 35 joints. Fine to enumerate but long. The spec json can include them all. dir for necks: direction of bone.

Mounts:
- `neckRoot` [0, 1.7, 1.6] — top of shoulders where necks emerge.
- `tailRoot` [0, 0.95, -0.6].
- `spineLine` maybe.

Actually mounts are where parts touch: necks attach to torso at neckRoot; heads attach to necks at neck tips. But heads are built by head parts while necks by neck part — they share mount points: each neck tip position. I'll define mounts: `neckBase` [0, 1.7, 1.6], `neckTipC` [0, 3.55, 2.75], `neckTipML` etc., `tailRoot` [0,0.95,-0.6].

Hmm, necks and heads: the neck part builds neck tubes up to the head joint; head parts build heads on head joints. Mount per head: 5 mounts. Plus tailRoot, neckBase.

Parts:
1. `torso` — box [[-1.35, 0, -1.0], [1.35, 2.0, 2.2]]. Builds serpent chest: big loft tube radius up to 1.1, belly plates (wide pale scales as rows), dorsal ridge spikes in dark bone, glowing teal rune sigils on flanks, scar/wear. Colors: scale greens/dark teal, God of War ashen. Palette: deep swamp green-grey scales, pale bone belly, dark horn, ember/teal glow (God of War ragnarok style: maybe rot-green). Let's do:

   - bone "#c9bfa4"
   - claw "#8a7a5c"
   - glowTeal "#3ce8c8" — Norse rune glow
   - emberOrange "#ff7a2e" — throat glow/fire
   - membrane "#7a2c3a"? webbing between jaw spikes maybe dark red
   - maw "#4a1420" mouth interior dark red
   - tooth "#e8e0c8"
   - eyeGlow "#ffd24a" (yellow glow eyes)
   - ink "#141a16" dark outline
   - rust/metal: God of War — the hydra maybe has chained armor? Keep it creature-only but could have broken chains/shackles — that's God of War flavor! Chains on necks/broken shackle on a horn. Add "ironOld" "#4a4a52", ironDark "#2e2e36".
   
   Palette up to 24. Let me list: scaleDark, scaleMid, scaleLight, belly, bellyEdge, horn, bone, claw, glowTeal, glowEmber, maw, tooth, eye, ink, iron, ironDark, moss... ~16.

2. `tail` — box [[-0.9, 0, -4.6], [0.9, 1.6, -0.2]]. Tail from tailRoot: thick taper, spikes along dorsal, bone spade/fin tip, belly plates continue. 130.

3. `necks` — five neck chains from neckBase to each head, sweeping S-curves, throat pale fronts, dorsal spikes/mane along each neck, collar scales. 170.

4. `headsCenter` — central head, richest: heavy skull, brow horns, open jaw (upper+lower), teeth, glowing eyes, throat ember glow, tongue, head crest. 200. Box around [0, 3.2, 2.2..3.6] plus jaw.

5. `headsSide` — the four flanking heads (2 mid + 2 outer), slightly varied, same construction mirrored. 200.

Budgets: 200+130+170+200+200 = 900. Good (at most 900).

Wait — heads in two parts but construction shared via spec: describe that mid and outer heads mirror the central one with variations. Spec must be explicit enough for independent builders to be consistent: sizes, colors, features.

Layout text: describe silhouette.

Joints: dir values. For a neck chain rising up and forward: dir [0, 1, 0.3]-ish. Let me define positions.

Body geometry: I'll define the torso tube centerline: from z=-0.8 (y=0.95) to z=1.6 (y=1.15), radius ~1.15 max at chest z~0.8. Belly rests on y=0: bottom = y_center - radius → center y ≈ radius. For radius 1.1, center y = 1.1. Hmm "low points touch the floor or sink by up to 2%". So spine center at y≈1.15 with radius 1.1 gives bottom at 0.05. OK.

Necks emerge from top of torso around z=1.4, y=1.9 (above spine surface). neckBase mount [0, 1.75, 1.5].

Neck chains (4 joints each + head):
- Central: base [0,1.75,1.5] → [0,2.6,2.0] → [0,3.2,2.4] → headC at [0,3.7,2.65]. Head aims forward-down.

Heights: headC ~3.9 top (skull radius ~0.35 → top 4.1). Size height 4.2 ok. Width: outer heads at x ±1.6 plus head width 0.8 → ±2.0. Size x 3.6? Outer necks bow outward — say x extent ±1.9 → size 3.8. Hmm, let me set size [3.6, 4.3, 6.6].
